title: GONG Multi-Channel Data for Solar Filaments
subtitle: GONG H-alpha frames 2023-2025 and bzi magnetograms matched to MAGFiLO 1.0

resources.description: Burst groups of the H-alpha frames (5 frames, offsets -4..+4 min) and counts of rejected frames by reason.
Match status of every MAGFiLO 1.0 training observation to a same-site bzi magnetogram: time gap (min), plage correlation, status ok / too far / no frames.

userSpecifiedSources: GONG H-alpha full-disk frames (haf, FITS), NSO Integrated Synoptic Program: https://gong2.nso.edu/HA/haf/
